observed.text: The narration says, “The stem it is now standing on was pointing straight up the whole time.”
The green top remains small and upright against the large black platter, with its lower stem/contact detail dark and difficult to distinguish.
Successive captions read “The stem it,” “is now standing,” “on was pointing,” “straight up the,” and “whole time.”
The video has no detected cuts, and the 6.4–13.9s portion is measured as a little-motion still stretch.

findings.viewer_understanding: The viewer can see that the top is upright, but may not be able to clearly verify the specific claim about which stem was pointing upward throughout.
findings.predicted_reaction: The surprising result remains watchable, but the final verbal explanation may feel less clear because the relevant stem geometry is not shown closely.
findings.weakness: The payoff explanation relies on a tiny, dark detail that the fixed wide framing does not make visually legible.
alternatives: The detail may be easier to see in motion than in the sampled frames.
The intended payoff may be the rise itself rather than a technical explanation of the stem.
findings.proposed_repair: Keep the uninterrupted rise, then add a brief close-up or a simple outline/arrow at the end identifying the stem that contacts the platter and its upright orientation.
